task_completion.description: Create a survey titled 'CARDIA Follow-Up Study - Participant Intake Form 2024'
task_completion.visual_evidence: The survey title is visible in the LimeSurvey admin header or survey list as 'CARDIA Follow-Up Study - Participant Intake Form 2024'.

task_completion.description: Create two question groups: 'Demographic Information' and 'Contact Preferences'
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Question groups' list or the survey structure sidebar shows exactly these two group names.

task_completion.description: Configure 'email' (email validation), 'age' (18-99), and 'zipcode' (5-digit regex) with mandatory status
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of question settings showing: 'email' with email validation/type, 'age' with min 18 and max 99, and 'zipcode' with a regex pattern like /\d{5}/. Mandatory (red asterisk) icons should be visible.
Question settings for 'income' showing range 0 to 10,000,000 and 'children' showing range 0 to 30.

task_completion.description: Configure 'contactmethod' (Radio: Email, Phone, Text Message, Postal Mail) and 'notes' (Long text, max 500 chars)
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'contactmethod' question shows the four specific answer options. The 'notes' question settings show a maximum character limit of 500.

task_completion.description: Activate the survey to make it live
task_completion.visual_evidence: The survey status indicator shows 'Active' (usually a green checkmark or 'This survey is currently active' message).

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the validation rules and question text
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the agent typing or pasting values into the specific LimeSurvey attribute fields (e.g., Validation, Min/Max value).

integrity.description: The agent did not leave default 'New Question' text
integrity.visual_evidence: All question titles and codes match the requirements (email, age, zipcode, etc.) rather than 'G01Q01'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey must be titled 'CARDIA Follow-Up Study - Participant Intake Form 2024'. There are 7 questions total across 2 groups. Key validations: Age (18-99), Zipcode (regex \d{5}), Income (0-10,000,000), Children (0-30), Notes (max 500 chars). All questions except 'notes' must be mandatory. The survey must be in 'Active' status at the end.
